issues.body: fetch_merge_group_runs requests status=completed, so queued/in-progress runs are absent rather than available for group_entries's incomplete-entry check. If an entry has two completed workflows and another still running, the returned subset passes every status/conclusion check and is profiled as a finished entry; the apparent closer, exclusive tail, and wall time can all be wrong. dropped_incomplete is therefore ineffective for live API data. The test_incomplete_entry_is_dropped_and_counted test is vacuous with respect to the real fetch path because it injects a state the query filters out.
issues.fix_hint: Fetch merge_group runs without the status=completed filter (or otherwise fetch/reconcile all statuses for every observed head_sha), then let group_entries drop and count entries containing any non-completed run. Add a fetch-path test that supplies a mixed completed/in-progress API population and proves the whole head_sha is dropped rather than profiling the completed subset.
issues.title: Completed-only API filter silently profiles partially running entries

verdict.summary: The profiler's API query excludes queued and in-progress workflow runs before entries are grouped. Consequently, a currently executing merge-group entry can appear to be a clean completed entry made only of its already-finished workflows, producing a false closer and understated wall time. This contradicts the stated population/fail-loud guarantees and is not covered by the hermetic test because that test injects an in-progress run directly into group_entries, a state the fetch path can never return.
